dedupe_keys.name: eba central register of payment and electronic money institutions under psd2

description: The EU register of authorised payment institutions and electronic money institutions. The EBA page says the central register, required by Article 15(1) of the Payment Services Directive (PSD2) and implementing and delegated regulations 2019/410 and 2019/411, holds information on payment and e-money institutions authorised or registered in the EU and EEA, supplied by national competent authorities, who update it at least once a day when their national registers change. The public can search it free and download its whole content from the site; the EBA also publishes other lists of institutions. Coverage is the EU and EEA. Caveats: accuracy rests with national authorities, and the download format is not stated on the page read. For simulation it lists the firms that run payment services in each country, a node list for payment network models and for checking concentration of payment providers. A related catalogue record is the ECB payments statistics.
